description: Trigger evaluation set for the research skill: queries that SHOULD activate it and near-miss negatives that should NOT. Used by the develop trigger smoke test and by `develop optimize`.
should_trigger: research the current state of solid-state batteries
look into whether GLP-1 drugs reduce cardiovascular risk
/research how do the major LLM providers price prompt caching
dig into the EU AI Act timeline and what it requires
find out about recent advances in perovskite solar cells
what is the current state of fusion startup funding
get me sources on the health effects of microplastics
I need to decide between two vendors, can you research them
is the claim that creatine helps cognition actually supported
compare the evidence for and against four-day work weeks
should_not_trigger: write me a short story about a lighthouse keeper
refactor this function to use async await
explain how a bicycle derailleur works
draft a thank-you email to my landlord
what is the capital of Australia
fix the bug in my Python script
summarize the file I just pasted
set a reminder for my dentist appointment tomorrow
notes: Near-misses are deliberately adjacent: established-knowledge questions (capital, arithmetic, how a mechanism works) are NOT research because no multi-source gathering is needed; creative, coding, and clerical tasks are out of scope. A borderline case like 'explain how X works' triggers only when X is contested or post-cutoff.
